integrity: The analytic proof supplies an all-level recurrence and a uniform continuum limit. Independent sample computations are reproducibility checks, not certification of the infinite statements.
scientific_limitations: Exact result for one specified unweighted digit set. Non-L2 does not assert singularity or exclusion of Lp for p<2; general finite-type spectral approaches and possible earlier exact tables are originality risks.
title: Exact correlation dimension and an L² obstruction for a three-digit four-adic convolution
